rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose attributive equivalent for something that occurs every day or every working day.

example.english: My daily breakfast is a cup of milk tea.
example.traditional: 我每日嘅早餐都係一杯奶茶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 ge3 zou2 caan1 dou1 hai6 jat1 bui1 naai5 caa4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something done every day.

example.jyutping: jat6 jat6 ngo5 dou1 jam2 gaa3 fe1

rows.note: Use this for a neutral or schedule-like statement that something happens every day.

example.english: I check the weather forecast daily before going to work.
example.traditional: 每日返工之前，我都會睇天氣預報。
example.jyutping: mui5 jat6 faan1 gung1 zi1 cin4 ngo5 dou1 wui5 tai2 tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3
